# Static standing-orders executor (CG3).
#
# The generated ck3llm_plans.txt sets each ruler's order variables
# (ck3llm_war_target = a claimed title, ck3llm_ally_target = a character) and
# calls this effect from within the ruler's scope each yearly pulse. Keeping the
# action logic and its readiness checks here means the generated file is data
# only: a bad generated file cannot carry a malformed effect, and the order is
# re-evaluated every year instead of firing once.
#
# Effect/trigger names verified against script_docs (CK3 1.20.0.4).

ck3llm_execute_orders = {
	# War order: keep a pressed claim on the target title (vanilla AI pursues it).
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = ck3llm_war_target
			exists = var:ck3llm_war_target
			NOT = { has_claim_on = var:ck3llm_war_target }
		}
		add_pressed_claim = var:ck3llm_war_target
	}
	# Alliance order: only to a living ruler we are not already allied to.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = ck3llm_ally_target
			exists = var:ck3llm_ally_target
			var:ck3llm_ally_target = { is_alive = yes }
			NOT = { is_allied_to = var:ck3llm_ally_target }
		}
		create_alliance = var:ck3llm_ally_target
	}
}
